assumptions: CPU rten route only: liqe_trunk.onnx runs once on the top-left 224x224 crop. Ort engines execute the 15-crop liqe_full.onnx graph and are outside this tally. Source: Liqe::from_dir and score_image.

Frozen trunk: 115605504 Conv MACs plus 4293206016 Gemm/MatMul MACs. Counts include the class token in the 50-token ViT sequence. Constants, tensor movement and shape bookkeeping are excluded from floating operation counts.

Graph pointwise counts use inferred static tensor shapes, not total_elem_ops (which includes constant payloads). Logical affine layer norm of width d per row: add=4*d-1, mul=2*d, div=d+2, sqrt=1. Stable softmax of n values: add=2*n-1, cmp=n-1, exp=n, div=n. Sigmoid: mul=1 for negation, add=1, exp=1, div=1. ReduceL2 counts squares, n-1 additions and one root. Conv/Gemm biases count one add per output.

The host f64 head still iterates all 15 copies of the embedding: 495*15*512 multiply/add pairs. It is not a single GEMV. Scale/add per patch, averaging, exponentials, bucket sums and final MOS are counted separately.

Partial model: graph copy traffic, global attention reach, span and buffers are not derived. Fixed crop costs apply only when both axes are at least 224; evaluator totals below that are algebraic extrapolations, not accepted scorer inputs. No timing or parity claim follows from these counts.
